crossRefs.note: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw…
(and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was…
This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is…
Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is…

translations.web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
translations.bsb: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
translations.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
translations.asv: This is the disciple that beareth witness of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his witness is true.
